title: SyRA-CS: Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation for Code-Switched ASR with Meta-Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code-switched (CS) automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains difficult because real CS speech is scarce and synthetic speech does not fully match it. We investigate whether synthetic CS speech is more useful for learning an adaptation-friendly initialization than for ordinary continual fine-tuning. We propose SyRA-CS, a pair-specific synthetic-to-real adaptation framework based on Reptile meta-learning. For each language pair and pretrained model, we meta-train on the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset and then adapt using one hour of labeled real target speech. We evaluate four architectural settings: Encoder-CTC, FastConformer-RNN-T, Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) and Speech-LLM. Experiments cover on Arabic-, French-, German-, and Hindi-English, against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning. SyRA-CS improves over continual fine-tuning on WER in all 16 model-pair comparisons and on CER in 15 o

translated_title: SyRA-CS：基于元学习的码切换语音识别合成到真实自适应
translated_abstract: 码切换自动语音识别（ASR）仍然是一个难题，因为真实的码切换语音非常稀缺，而合成语音又无法完全匹配真实语音。我们研究合成码切换语音是否更适合用于学习一个利于自适应的初始化，而不是用于普通的持续微调。我们提出了SyRA-CS，一个基于Reptile元学习的、针对特定语言对的合成到真实自适应框架。对于每个语言对和预训练模型，我们在相应的合成CS-FLEURS子集上进行元训练，然后仅使用一小时带标注的真实目标语音进行自适应。我们评估了四种架构设置：Encoder-CTC、FastConformer-RNN-T、注意力编码器-解码器（AED）以及语音大语言模型（Speech-LLM）。实验覆盖阿拉伯语-英语、法语-英语、德语-英语和印地语-英语等语言对，并与仅合成数据迁移、仅真实数据微调以及持续微调方法进行对比。SyRA-CS在全部16个模型-语言对组合的WER指标以及15个组合的CER指标上均优于持续微调。
tldr: 提出基于Reptile元学习的SyRA-CS框架，利用合成码切换语音学习易于自适应的模型初始化，仅需一小时真实目标语音即可在所有16个模型-语言对组合上超越持续微调的码切换语音识别性能。
en_tdlr: SyRA-CS employs Reptile meta-learning on synthetic code-switched speech to learn adaptation-friendly initializations, enabling code-switched ASR to outperform continual fine-tuning across all 16 model-language pair comparisons with just one hour of labeled real target speech.
